description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractBinary' in the Twig templating engine representing binary expressions in the AST. It provides constructor logic for left and right operands and a compile method that outputs PHP code for the binary operation, with subclasses expected to implement the 'operator' method.

classes.name: AbstractBinary
classes.description: Abstract class for binary expressions in the Twig AST, handling common logic for left/right operands and compilation infrastructure.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the left and right nodes, issuing deprecation warnings if they are not instances of AbstractExpression, and calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the binary expression into PHP code, outputting parentheses, the left operand, the operator, and the right operand.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to output the specific binary operator during compilation.
